prompt:
Create a narrow-screen responsive version of the attached approved Private Client Graph proposal review page. Portrait actual mobile web page at 768x1536, representing a 390 CSS-pixel wide viewport at 2x resolution, edge-to-edge with NO phone frame. Keep the exact reference colours #F6F6F1 paper, #173E38 ink, white surfaces, fine rules, Public Sans body, Newsreader restrained headings. Top compact horizontal header Private Client Graph and neutral account icon, Matters link on a separate second line, no hamburger. Persistent notice 'Synthetic or fictional material only. No real client information.' Main 20px CSS side margins, Back to Matters, h1 Evergreen family trust wrapping naturally, reference SYN-2026-014, 'Awaiting confirmation. Your proposal is saved.'
Single column review: section heading Proposed relationships followed by a usable horizontally pannable graph viewport at 290 CSS-pixel height. For the image show two person rectangles Eleanor Vale, Thomas Vale at top, Maya Vale lower left and upright triangular Vale Family Trust lower right with label below. Same directed relations Eleanor parent of Maya, Eleanor settlor of Trust, Thomas trustee of Trust selected burgundy, Maya beneficiary of Trust, spouse line between Eleanor and Thomas. Keep edge labels readable, node names wrap if needed; no tiny desktop shrink. Below graph selected relationship 'Thomas Vale · trustee of · Vale Family Trust', exact quote 'Thomas Vale is the trustee of the Vale Family Trust.' and explicit underlined 'View in source' link. Next white source section begins with Authoritative Source, Fictional attendance note, and source paragraph with the trustee sentence highlighted pale gold. Show visible beginning of source with enough text to prove relationship between selection and source. Natural document scroll continues downward; at bottom of long page include normal-flow decision section 'Accept this proposal?' with sentence 'Accepts the whole graph and source as current Matter state.' Full-width primary 'Confirm and create Matter', 'Back to Matters' secondary, quiet 'Discard intake' separately beneath. No sticky bar covering source. If entire content needs longer height, prioritize readable mobile scale over forcing content into viewport; a full-page long screenshot up to 2000px tall is acceptable. Professional calm layout, no cards or badges. This is a responsive design study, no invented review-progress tracker.
reference: Selected graph-led Matter Ledger direction; see ../../practitioner-matter-workflow-design.md.
